name: Hapa Productivity Metrics Projection
source: Local Hapa Second Brain ledger; Catalog may surface projections but is not the canonical owner.

interpretation.turn: A paired user-and-assistant conversation unit in the Hapa turn ledger.
interpretation.skillCluster: A derived recurring skill pattern; it is not a credential or employer rating.
interpretation.resultLink: A derived relationship between a turn and a result record, used for lineage navigation.
interpretation.estimatedTextTokens: A text-volume proxy calculated as total prompt and response characters divided by four. It is not a provider-reported, billable, cached, or reasoning-token total.

sourceBoundary: Metrics describe a local derived projection at a point in time. They do not prove public availability, customer usage, deployment maturity, or commercial outcomes.
